verdict.rationale: Docs clearly support agent-driven provisioning (getSandbox), code execution (exec, Python/JS interpreter with stdin/stdout capture), and reading results (readFile, rich outputs, real-time streaming), fully enabling an autonomous exec/read loop. However, teardown is not explicitly documented as an agent-callable destroy API, and community feedback notes there's no auto-destroy on idle timeout, forcing manual cleanup implementation — undermining a fully autonomous end-to-end lifecycle. missing for 10: explicit sandbox.destroy()/teardown API documentation, evidence of automatic idle-based cleanup, and independent hands-on confirmation of the full provision-to-teardown loop working without human intervention.
